catnip.about: Windows updates the last-access stamp at most about once an hour, so an open inside the hour a file arrived counts as never. Purrge and Mouser read files and put the stamp back; Chonk never opens one.
catnip.accessoff: Windows is set not to record when files are opened, so the ages here are when each file was made or last changed, not when it was last looked at. Something opened yesterday can show as untouched for a year.
catnip.description: Finds what was downloaded and never opened, by when it was last touched rather than how big or how old it is.
catnip.empty: What was downloaded and never opened, least recently touched first. Windows keeps the stamp; nothing else reads it, and nothing in Meows disturbs it.
catnip.error.purrge: Purrge would not take the question.
catnip.headline.idle: {0} files, {1}, untouched for {2} days or more; the oldest last opened {3}.
catnip.headline.never: {0} files, {1}, not opened since they arrived, untouched for {2} days or more; the oldest from {3}.
catnip.headline.none: {0} files walked; nothing untouched for {1} days.
catnip.multi.hint: Ctrl-click or Shift-click picks several; Recycle Bin and the Purrge question take them all.
catnip.none: Nothing matches the dials. Widen them, or enjoy the tidy folder.
catnip.onlynever.hint: Off shows everything untouched for the window, opened once or not.
catnip.open.hint: The one honest way off the list: the stamp moves, and the row goes.
catnip.purrge.hint: Purrge walks the drives these sit on, opening only files of exactly their sizes, and the answer lands on the status line.
catnip.records.recycled: sent something to the Recycle Bin
catnip.roots.hint: Downloads by default. Add the folders things get saved to and forgotten in; a folder handed over from another tab is added and walked.
